_comment: Names given to N64Recomp in place of the real ones from functions.json (applied by tools/gen_syms.py).
game_*: libultra functions N64Recomp would replace with the runtime's versions, but we want the game's
own copy recompiled (Controller Pak filesystem: the runtime has no Controller Pak emulation).
cspeed_*: functions implemented in src/game (listed as ignored in cspeed.us.toml); these are the only
places the Controller Pak code touches the Serial Interface.
